title: A dsh notice is readable, the chat box keeps focus after '/help <question>', and Help answers about Stop and long requests without claiming to see live state
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/assistant.test.mjs packages/ui/tracy-assistant/test/help.test.mjs packages/ui/tracy-assistant/test/chat.test.mjs

S2: Record the exit code and the result of the cases named: "Help prompt: knows the Stop square of the chat box and never claims to see whether a task is running"; "Help prompt: answers stay short even when asked for everything, so they fit the output limit".

S3: node scripts/build-api-spec.mjs is not needed. Run: pnpm exec tsx scripts/check-dsh-tokens.ts && pnpm exec tsx scripts/check-bundles.ts and read that packages/brand/tracy-brand/src/client/generated.ts no longer maps --dsw-alias-toast-bg to var(--popover).

S4 (stand, tasks/bang-chung/lan-3-kiem-lai-day-du/): dsh native + tracy-web + real models, dsh built from fork 0.2.0-rc.2-tracy.24. Attach a file to the chat box, type '/help hi there', Enter: the notice "/help does not accept attachments; remove them first" has dark text on a dark surface (readable: computed colour differs from its background). Then type '/help what is a Diff?', Enter, and without clicking type more: the keystrokes land in the chat box. Any other argued slash line the catalog handles (not only /help) behaves the same.

S5 (fork, vendor/tracy/deepseek-harness): ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run packages/client/ui-conversation packages/client/ui-commands - 46 files, 702 tests green, among them the three cases of "an argued line a command handles returns the keyboard to the composer" (focus returns; a control the person moved to keeps it; a composer that never had it does not grab it).
expect: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0'; both prompt cases are 'ok'. The prompt states that the send arrow turns into a red Stop square while Tracy works, forbids saying that a task is or is not running, and asks for answers under about 250 words even for 'everything'.
S3: both gates pass and the generated brand tokens no longer set --dsw-alias-toast-bg (dsh's own dark toast surface stays, so its white label is readable).

S4: the toast's text colour and its background colour differ; after '/help <question>' the active element is the chat box (data-composer-input) and typing continues in it without a click, with no frame-loop workaround left in the plugin.
S5: the fork specs exit 0; the first of the three focus cases is red on fork 0.2.0-rc.2-tracy.23 and green on tracy.24.
evidence: Found 07/10/2026 while running the remaining cases of tasks/todo-lenh-help.md on a real stack: tasks/bang-chung/lan-3-kiem-lai-day-du/KET-QUA.md (23/23 + 21/21 + 18/18 + 6/6 + 42 agent cases; unit suites 69/69).
fence: Help still cannot stop or change anything; it only tells the person where the Stop square is, and it never states whether a task is running because it only has records of past turns.

tests: Help prompt: knows the Stop square of the chat box and never claims to see whether a task is running
Help prompt: answers stay short even when asked for everything, so they fit the output limit
